svg.text: Left hand, palm up, fingers together and straight.
Millimetres. Skip any you like: the defaults fill in.
Hand length: wrist crease to middle fingertip
Palm length: wrist crease to middle base crease
Hand breadth: across the knuckles, no thumb
Index finger: base crease to fingertip
Middle finger: base crease to fingertip
Ring finger: base crease to fingertip
Index base crease: how far behind the middle's
Ring base crease: how far behind the middle's
Pinky base crease: how far behind the middle's
Thumb reach: wrist crease to thumb tip
Thumb tip: last joint crease to thumb tip
Write them in cad/hand.local.toml, a copy of hand.example.toml.
Git ignores it, so your numbers stay on your computer.
